newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel little changed vs dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel little changed vs dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel closed almost unchanged on Tuesday against the dollar and the basket of foreign currencies in thin trading, dealers said.

"Trading was very quiet today and activity was minimal. After two weeks of active trading (in which the shekel fell sharply) it seems now that the shekel will remain at the current level in the near future," said a trader at Bank Hapoalim.
"The shekel traded in a narrow range. Activity abroad was also low as investors wait for the results of the U.S. elections and for news of (Russian leader) Yeltsin's operation," he said.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2480 shekels against 3.2490 on Monday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, closed at 3.6470 shekels against 3.6477 on Monday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8504 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8708 on Monday and against the mark at 2.1440 shekels against 2.1468 on Monday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2460 shekels.
